items.name: Kasia
items.says: An encrypted, decentralized, peer-to-peer messaging protocol and application built on Kaspa.
items.code_note: Its site says the code is open source on GitHub.

items.name: KaChat (and .kachat names)
items.says: Encrypted, peer-to-peer chat and KAS payments on Kaspa. No accounts, no phone numbers: your wallet is your identity.
items.code_note: The .kachat names project is part of KaChat; its site links to both.
